lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 12 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiaag sagal siaanapaa bhaj paarabraham nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: Renounce all your cleverness and remember the Supreme, Formless Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek saache naam baajhahu sagal deesai chhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh jaaneeai sad sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Know that God is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaadee boojheeai ek har kai ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one understands, and is imbued with the Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran samarath ek keree doojaa naahee thaau ||
lines.translation: Seek the Shelter of the One All-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa bhaujal la(n)gheeai sadaa har gun gaau ||2||
lines.translation: The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, singing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran nivaareeai dukh na jam pur hoi ||
lines.translation: Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the City of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan soee paae kripaa kare prabh soi ||3||
lines.translation: He alone obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God shows His Mercy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek tek adhaar eko ek kaa man jor ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is my Anchor and Support; the One Lord alone is the power of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak japeeai mil saadhasa(n)gat har bin avar na hor ||4||1||136||
lines.translation: O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him; without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||4||1||136||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu man tan praan prabh ke deee sabh ras bhog ||
lines.translation: The soul, the mind, the body and the breath of life belong to God. He has given all tastes and pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen ba(n)dhap jee daataa saran raakhan jog ||1||
lines.translation: He is the Friend of the poor, the Giver of life, the Protector of those who seek His Sanctuary. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man dhiaai har har naau ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat sahaai sa(n)ge ek siu liv laau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, He is our Helper and Companion; embrace love and affection for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed saasatr jan dhiaavahi taran kau sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: They meditate on the Vedas and the Shaastras, to swim across the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam anek kiriaa sabh oopar naam achaar ||2||
lines.translation: The many religious rituals, good deeds of karma and Dharmic worship - above all of these is the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar binasai milai satigur dev ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism depart, meeting with the Divine True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam driR kar bhagat har kee bhalee prabh kee sev ||3||
lines.translation: Implant the Naam within, perform devotional worship to the Lord and serve God - this is good. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran daiaal teree too(n) nimaane maan ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord; You are the Honor of the dishonored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan adhaar teraa naanak kaa prabh taan ||4||2||137||
lines.translation: You are the Support of my soul, my breath of life; O God, You are Nanak's strength. ||4||2||137||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: dol dol mahaa dukh paaiaa binaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: He wavers and falters, and suffers such great pain, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khaat laabh gobi(n)d har ras paarabraham ik ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: The profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe is obtained, by the Love of the One Supreme Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ko naam japeeai neet ||
lines.translation: Chant continually the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas dhiaai so prabh tiaag avar pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, meditate on God, and renounce other love. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath so prabh jee daataa aap ||
lines.translation: God is the Doer, the All-powerful Cause of causes; He Himself is the Giver of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tiaag sagal siaanapaa aath pahar prabh jaap ||2||
lines.translation: So renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet sakhaa sahaai sa(n)gee ooch agam apaar ||
lines.translation: He is our best friend and companion, our help and support; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal basaai hiradai jee ko aadhaar ||3||
lines.translation: Enshrine His Lotus Feet within your heart; He is the Support of the soul. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh paarabraham gun teraa jas gaau ||
lines.translation: Show Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh vadee vadiaaee jap jeevai naanak naau ||4||3||138||
lines.translation: Total peace, and the greatest greatness, O Nanak, are obtained by living to chant the Name of the Lord. ||4||3||138||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam karau karaavahu thaakur pekhat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: I make the effort, as You cause me to do, my Lord and Master, to behold You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam charaavahu ra(n)gan aape hee prabh ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: I am imbued with the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har; God Himself has colored me in His Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mahi raam naamaa jaap ||
lines.translation: I chant the Lord's Name within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa vasahu merai hiradai hoi sahaaee aap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun naam tumaaraa preetam prabh pekhan kaa chaau ||
lines.translation: Listening continually to Your Name, O Beloved God, I yearn to behold You.
